object_types.name: Shipment
object_types.definition: A consignment of goods that moves through the logistics network and is tracked by a shipment number.

source_references.excerpt: We track shipments -- consignments, some of the older staff say, same thing. Each shipment has a shipment number.
For example, shipment S-100 contains product P-77 in quantity 5.

object_types.name: ShipmentNumber
object_types.definition: The unique identifier assigned to a shipment.

source_references.excerpt: Each shipment has a shipment number.
shipment S-100

object_types.name: Product
object_types.definition: A type of goods that can be included in shipments, identified by a Stock Keeping Unit (SKU).

source_references.excerpt: Products are identified by SKU. For example, shipment S-100 contains product P-77 in quantity 5.

object_types.name: SKU
object_types.definition: Stock Keeping Unit: the unique identifier for a product.

source_references.excerpt: Products are identified by SKU.

object_types.name: Quantity
object_types.definition: The number of units of a product in a shipment.

source_references.excerpt: A shipment contains products, each in a specific quantity. For example, shipment S-100 contains product P-77 in quantity 5.

object_types.name: Warehouse
object_types.definition: A physical storage location where shipments can be held.

source_references.excerpt: A shipment can be split across warehouses -- up to three warehouses per shipment. Warehouses have a warehouse code.

object_types.name: WarehouseCode
object_types.definition: The unique identifier for a warehouse.

source_references.excerpt: Warehouses have a warehouse code.

ambiguities.description: Policy change on warehouse capacity: The transcript mentions an explicit change from 'up to three warehouses per shipment' to 'at most two warehouses'. This is correctly captured as the current constraint (max 2), but it should be verified whether historical data or older shipments should be migrated or whether the new policy applies only to future shipments. The model reflects the current policy but temporal validity is not addressed.

ambiguities.description: Quantity representation: The model treats Quantity as a simple integer value type. It is unclear whether negative quantities (returns), fractional quantities (partial units), or zero quantities are allowed. The transcript example shows '5' but does not establish bounds or precision requirements.

The transcript treats it as current-state assignment only, but it may need clarification whether warehouse history should be maintained.
